evidence.observation: Growth pressure was 2.897 Torr at approximately 100 sccm Ar.
Pressure has risen progressively to 3.175 Torr despite unchanged growth setpoints and stable measured Ar flow.
Temperature is 750.3 °C against 750 °C setpoint; Ar is 99.2 sccm against 100 sccm setpoint.
Exhaust O2 sensor is not installed; atmosphere verification is unavailable.
Growth requires an exhaust O2 sensor, which is absent.

args.missing_evidence: Validated exhaust O2 measurement is required to verify the atmosphere; pressure-reference data and leak/exhaust-conductance checks are needed to determine the cause of the pressure rise. No sample characterization is available.
